q-0361.answer:
Surah An-Nahl (16) — The Bee · 128 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• Finding Consolation in the Reminder of Those Who came before
• It will not be delayed for them, rather they will be taken quickly from the place of gathering, with no calling to account.
• Those who oppose you, for Allah has decreed that this should happen.
• They will see and hear better than they have ever seen and heard before.

Full ayah text and tafsir are available in the sources below.

sources.snippet: Quran 16:1. Arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ أَتَىٰٓ أَمْرُ ٱللَّهِ فَلَا تَسْتَعْجِلُوهُ ۚ سُبْحَٰنَهُۥ وَتَعَٰلَىٰ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ. English: The command of Allah is coming, so be not impatient for it. Exalted is He and high above what they associate with Him.. Urdu: خدا کا حکم (یعنی عذاب گویا) آ ہی پہنچا تو (کافرو) اس کے لیے جلدی مت کرو۔ یہ لوگ جو (خدا کا) شریک بناتے ہیں وہ اس سے پاک اور بالاتر ہے.

Quran 16:2. Arabic: يُنَزِّلُ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةَ بِٱلرُّوحِ مِنْ أَمْرِهِۦ عَلَىٰ مَن يَشَآءُ مِنْ عِبَادِهِۦٓ أَنْ أَنذِرُوٓا۟ أَنَّهُۥ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّآ أَنَا۠ فَٱتَّقُونِ. English: He sends down the angels, with the inspiration of His command, upon whom He wills of His servants, [telling them], "Warn that there is no deity except Me; so fear Me.". Urdu: وہی فرشتوں کو پیغام دے کر اپنے حکم سے اپنے بندوں میں سے جس کے پاس چاہتا ہے بھیجتا ہے کہ (لوگوں کو) بتادو کہ میرے سوا کوئی معبود نہیں تو مجھی سے ڈرو.

Quran 16:3. Arabic: خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ بِٱلْحَقِّ ۚ تَعَٰلَىٰ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ. English: He created the heavens and earth in truth. High is He above what they associate with Him.. Urdu: اسی نے آسمانوں اور زمین کو مبنی برحکمت پیدا کیا۔ اس کی ذات ان (کافروں) کے شرک سے اونچی ہے.

Quran 16:64. Arabic: وَمَآ أَنزَلْنَا عَلَيْكَ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ إِلَّا لِتُبَيِّنَ لَهُمُ ٱلَّذِى ٱخْتَلَفُوا۟ فِيهِ ۙ وَهُدًۭى وَرَحْمَةًۭ لِّقَوْمٍۢ يُؤْمِنُونَ. English: And We have not revealed to you the Book, [O Muhammad], except for you to make clear to them that wherein they have differed and as guidance and mercy for a people who believe.. Urdu: اور ہم نے جو تم پر کتاب نازل کی ہے تو اس کے لیے جس امر میں ان لوگوں کو اختلاف ہے تم اس کا فیصلہ کردو۔ اور (یہ) مومنوں کے لیے ہدایت اور رحمت ہے.

Quran 16:127. Arabic: وَٱصْبِرْ وَمَا صَبْرُكَ إِلَّا بِٱللَّهِ ۚ وَلَا تَحْزَنْ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا تَكُ فِى ضَيْقٍۢ مِّمَّا يَمْكُرُونَ. English: And be patient, [O Muhammad], and your patience is not but through Allah. And do not grieve over them and do not be in distress over what they conspire.. Urdu: اور صبر ہی کرو اور تمہارا صبر بھی خدا ہی کی مدد سے ہے اور ان کے بارے میں غم نہ کرو اور جو یہ بداندیشی کرتے ہیں اس سے تنگدل نہ ہو.

q-0677.answer:
Surah At-Tin (95) — The Fig · 8 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• To the Hellfire. This was said by Mujahid, Abu Al-'Aliyah, Al-Hasan, Ibn Zayd and others.
• In the recompense that will take place in the Hereafter.
• It would not be correct to exclude the believers from this, because some of them are also overcome by the senility of old age.

Full ayah text and tafsir are available in the sources below.

q-0743.answer:
Surah Al-Masad (111) — The Palm Fibre · 5 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• May the hands of Abu Lahab be ruined, and ruined is he.
• His wealth will not avail him or that which he gained.
• He will [enter to] burn in a Fire of [blazing] flame
• And his wife [as well] - the carrier of firewood.
• Around her neck is a rope of [twisted] fiber.

Full ayah text and tafsir are available in the sources below.

q-0800.answer:
Quran 3:7 — Aal-i-Imraan (The Family of Imraan)

هُوَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنزَلَ عَلَيْكَ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ مِنْهُ ءَايَٰتٌۭ مُّحْكَمَٰتٌ هُنَّ أُمُّ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ وَأُخَرُ مُتَشَٰبِهَٰتٌۭ ۖ فَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ فِى قُلُوبِهِمْ زَيْغٌۭ فَيَتَّبِعُونَ مَا تَشَٰبَهَ مِنْهُ ٱبْتِغَآءَ ٱلْفِتْنَةِ وَٱبْتِغَآءَ تَأْوِيلِهِۦ ۗ وَمَا يَعْلَمُ تَأْوِيلَهُۥٓ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُ ۗ وَٱلرَّٰسِخُونَ فِى ٱلْعِلْمِ يَقُولُونَ ءَامَنَّا بِهِۦ كُلٌّۭ مِّنْ عِندِ رَبِّنَا ۗ وَمَا يَذَّكَّرُ إِلَّآ أُو۟لُوا۟ ٱلْأَلْبَٰبِ

Transliteration: Huwal lazeee anzala 'alaikal Kitaaba minhu Aayaatum Muh kamaatun hunna Ummul Kitaabi wa ukharu Mutashaabihaatun faammal lazeena fee quloobihim ziyghun fa yattabi'oona ma tashaabaha minhubtighaaa 'alfitnati wabtighaaa'a taaweelih; wa maa ya'lamu taaweelahooo illal laah; warraasikhoona fil 'ilmi yaqooloona aamannaa bihee kullum min 'indi Rabbinaa; wa maa yazzakkaru illaaa ulul albaab

Translation: It is He who has sent down to you, [O Muhammad], the Book; in it are verses [that are] precise - they are the foundation of the Book - and others unspecific. As for those in whose hearts is deviation [from truth], they will follow that of it which is unspecific, seeking discord and seeking an interpretation [suitable to them]. And no one knows its [true] interpretation except Allah. But those firm in knowledge say, "We believe in it. All [of it] is from our Lord." And no one will be reminded except those of understanding.

q-4916.answer:
Surah Al-Lail (92) — The Night · 21 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• Proving that Allah rewards those who intend good with success, while whoever intends evil is abandoned, and all of this is in accordance with a preordained decree.
• Hoping to attain the blessing of seeing Him in the final abode in the Gardens of Paradise.
• The recompense in the abode of the Hereafter.
• The righteous, pure, most pious person will be saved from the Fire.
• The actions of the servants that they have performed are also opposites and diverse.

q-5515.answer:
Surah An-Naba (78) — The Announcement · 40 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• Refutation against the Idolators' Denial of the Occurrence of the Day of Judgement
• Explaining the Day of Decision and what occurs during it
• The Day of Judgement. It is mentioned here to emphasize the fact that its occurrence has become close, because everything that is coming will certainly come to pass.
• What are they asking about? They are asking about the matter of the Day of Judgement, and it is the great news.
• They used to deny the evidences of Allah and His proofs for His creation, which He revealed to His Messengers.

c-0015.answer:
No — twice over. Killing civilians is categorically forbidden: "Whoever kills a soul — unless for murder or corruption in the land — it is as if he had slain all mankind" (Quran 5:32); the Prophet ﷺ forbade killing women, children and non-combatants even in declared war (Sahih al-Bukhari 3015), and even condemned burning as a punishment. Suicide is separately and absolutely forbidden: "Do not kill yourselves" (4:29); "Whoever kills himself with something will be punished with it on the Day of Resurrection" (Sahih al-Bukhari 6047). An act combining both prohibitions cannot be worship.

This is not a modern apologetic — it is the ruling of the mainstream scholarship of every school. The Amman Message (2004) — endorsed by over 500 scholars from 84 countries — and the 2014 Open Letter of 126 senior scholars to ISIS declared such violence a betrayal of Islamic law point by point. Statistically, the overwhelming majority of victims of terrorist groups claiming Islam are themselves Muslims — the mosques, markets and funerals they bomb are full of the people they claim to represent.
